content:
Mariah Carey seemingly called out concertgoers over concerns that she appeared unusually “stiff” during a recent kickoff concert for her Christmas Time tour in Brazil.

In a video posted online from Carey’s Nov. 21 show at the Farmasi Arena in Rio de Janeiro, she told the crowd, “And by the way, don’t believe everything you read online. Don’t be making me mad now.”

Carey’s comments follow the Nov. 17 performance in São Paulo of her 1995 tune “Fantasy,” which went viral after fans on X pointed out that Carey was escorted by backup dancers onstage and seemed to move gingerly.

In one clip, the Grammy winner was singing in a stationary position before a backup dancer took her hand and walked with her to the center of the stage.

Representatives for Carey didn’t immediately respond to HuffPost’s request for comment.

The “All I Want for Christmas Is You” singer’s Christmas Time concert series runs through Dec. 12, with upcoming shows in the U.K., Malta and Abu Dhabi.

Carey has also announced plans for her 2027 Firefly Tour, consisting of a nine-show European run slated for June and July next year.
